We multiply each entry of $F$ by $4$ and each entry of $G$ by $\frac{1}{2},$ and then subtract the resulting matrices, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4F-\frac{1}{2}G & =4[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 4 & -6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4\cdot 4 & 4\cdot (-1) & 4\cdot 0 & 4\cdot 2\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2 & \frac{1}{2}\cdot 0 & \frac{1}{2}\cdot 4 & \frac{1}{2}\cdot (-6)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}16 & -4 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}16-1 & -4-0 & 0-2 & 8-(-3)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}15 & -4 & -2 & 11\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
